Hi Larkspur team,

I'm really excited about our company launch event and I'm thinking it would be amazing to hire your Countess for it. We'd love to pick it up on Wednesday 5 May 2027 at 11:30 and bring it back on 6th May 2027 at 09:00. We'll actually collect it from your garage. According to your website, the total comes to 576.00 euros. I've attached my driving licence.

Cheers,
Silas Sedgewick-Rowe
